6. On the first floor, Flat 104, 105 and meter room were inspected. The two kitchens of Flat 104 and 105 were nearest to the Lightwell Platform.  

7. In the kitchen of Flat 104, the fixed electrical installations and electrical products were found seriously burnt by fire externally. The fixed electrical installations and electrical products included a ceiling lighting, a range hood, a washing machine, a refrigerator, a microwave oven, a conventional oven, toaster, a distribution board and socket outlet. There was no sign of electrical fault identified from these fixed electrical installations and electrical products (Photo A1 to A8). Other areas of Flat 104 (i.e. Living and Dining Rooms, Bedrooms, Bathroom) were also affected by fire externally (Photo A9 to A12). There was no evidence to show the fire was initiated from fixed electrical installation nor electrical product in Flat 104 and the fire is not electrically related.
